title: Reddit, Inc. — Consensus Investment Report
subtitle: A structured debate between six independent investment frameworks — Buffett owner-earnings value, Munger multidisciplinary quality, Damodaran fundamental valuation, Druckenmiller macro-first expectations, Soros reflexivity, and Minervini trend trading (standalone) — reconciled into a single synthesized analysis and recommendation.

exec_summary.lead: Reddit is one of the rarest assets in consumer internet — a wide-moat community network (“the toll booth on human conversation”) growing revenue 66.6% TTM at 91.4% gross margins with $2.77B net cash — but ~50% of its traffic is rented from Google, its per-share economics carry a $338M/yr SBC tax, and the stock has been re-rated −46% from its high on a single Google-related disclosure event. Six independent analyses, using six different frameworks, all refused to buy at **$151.71**: five converge on **C — Hold/Watch** (Druckenmiller C+, Soros a conditional B−), and Minervini reads the tape as a standalone trading D. The business is not in dispute; the Google referral pathway, the SBC treatment, and a price that embeds ~53% first-year growth are.

profiles_title: The Five Positions at the Table
profiles_lead: Each participant analyzed Reddit independently. Their positions were then cross-examined in the debate. Minervini's trading lens stands outside the valuation consensus.

profiles.name: Warren Buffett
profiles.paragraph: Three-scenario SBC-adjusted owner-earnings DCF (10–12% discount, terminal growth ≤3%): bear **$65**, base **$123**, bull **$251**, weighted **~$131** (30/50/20). “A wonderful business at a price that already pays for a great deal of the future — ~43× FCF once stock-based compensation is treated as the real cost it is.” Buyer at **$85–95**; compelling below **$75**; reduce above **$180**.

profiles.name: Charlie Munger
profiles.paragraph: Conservative net-of-SBC DCF (16.5% discount, 2% terminal growth): bear **$27**, base **$40**, bull **$50**, weighted **~$35**; even ignoring SBC entirely, base is only $60. “The wonderful company at a wonderful price — and wonderful prices are how wonderful companies become mediocre investments.” Starter below **$45**, conviction below **$35**; reduce at or above **$150**.

profiles.name: Aswath Damodaran
profiles.paragraph: Verified five-scenario FCFF workbook (12.0% WACC, 3.0% terminal growth, 24% normalized tax): bear **$45.27**, conservative **$70.40**, base **$109.50**, optimistic **$194.16**, bull **$423.27**; weighted **$141.61** = **−6.7%** expected upside and **−1.4%** 5-yr annualized. The price embeds ~53% Y1 growth. Buy **$75–95**, conviction below **$75**; reduce at or above **$190**.

profiles.name: Stanley Druckenmiller
profiles.paragraph: 12-month price paths bear **$120** / base **$165** / bull **$210**, weighted **~$161**, plus tails **$88** (10%) and **$290** (5%). “Buy the Google-panic dislocation in the best ad business on the internet, if and when it arrives below ~$135.” Expected ~+6% at $151.71; >+20% entered at $120–135. Buy zone **$110–135**; reduce above **$215**.

profiles.name: George Soros
profiles.paragraph: 12-month paths bear **$120** / base **$165** / bull **$210**, weighted **~$171**, extremes **$95** (10%) and **$270** (10%). The AI-victim narrative has overshot reality — monetization (ads +64%, US ARPU +51%) has decoupled from traffic; 10% short interest plus a $1B buyback plus a binary Google-renewal catalyst create ~2.2:1 asymmetry. Scale in **$115–140**; reduce above **$205**.

debate.title: The Debate: Agreement, Contention, Resolution
debate.lead: Round 1: opening statements. Round 2: uncontested common ground. Round 3: six disputed points, cross-examined to resolution. Round 4: final concessions. Minervini's trading view is recorded but stands outside the valuation consensus.
agreements: **The franchise is exceptional.** 91.4% gross margin, 28.25% operating margin, 36.7% FCF margin, ~$7.5M TTM capex, $2.77B net cash, 8 straight quarters of 60%+ revenue growth.

**The moat is wide on the community side, rented on the distribution side.** The 20-year, 26B+ post corpus and two-sided network effect are genuinely defensible; ~50% of traffic arriving via Google is not.
**SBC is the per-share tax.** $338M TTM = 12.2% of revenue and ~39% of net income; how each lens treats it is the single largest driver of the valuation spread.
**The Q2'26 print was a template event, not an operating collapse.** −21% on 2026-07-30 while revenue grew +61.1% — the market repriced the Google referral pathway, not the P&L.
**No margin of safety at $151.71.** Five of six lenses place their central value below the price; nobody calls the stock cheap.
**The S&P 500 inclusion was a flow event, not a story change.** +16.5% on 08-14 fully faded by 08-19; index membership does not change the Google dependency.
**Google is a four-way dependency** — traffic source (~50%), advertising rival, AI-disintermediator (AI Overviews), and licensing customer (~$60M/yr, renewal in doubt).
**Unanimous: do not initiate at $151.71.** C (Buffett), C (Munger), C (Damodaran), C+ (Druckenmiller), B− (Soros), D-trading (Minervini). No outright buyer today; no one shorts the moat.
**One valuation-critical variable: the durability of Google-sourced traffic.** Every lens, in its own vocabulary, lands on the same hinge.
**The distribution is wide and two-tailed.** Beta 2.03; bear cases −70% to −85%; bull tails +78% to +179%; a binary licensing renewal; a crowded short base.
debate.contentions_title: Contested points — and how they were resolved
contentions: **Reference-price framing: intrinsic value vs 12-month price paths.** Buffett/Munger/Damodaran publish intrinsic values; Druckenmiller ($120/165/210) and Soros ($95–270) publish 12-month price expectations; Minervini publishes trend extrapolations. Damodaran: “mixing price paths into a scenario table is how consensus reports manufacture precision.” **Concessions:** Druckenmiller and Soros each concede their cells are price paths, not IV. **Resolved:** the three fundamental models set the consensus IV (workbook as anchor); the macro lenses inform the near-term ladder and triggers only.

**Where does base-case intrinsic value actually sit? The 3× spread.** Munger **$40** (net-of-SBC at 16.5% discount, 2% tg), Damodaran **$109.50** (verified workbook, 12.0% WACC), Buffett **$123** (SBC-adjusted, 14% growth at 11%). The SBC treatment is the crux. **Concessions:** Munger concedes $40 is a never-pay floor, not a central estimate (his no-SBC variant: $60); Damodaran concedes his model assumes SBC discipline rather than expensing the current bill; Buffett concedes $123 is “what it is worth if it compounds,” not what he would pay. **Resolved:** consensus base ≈ **~$100**; Buffett's $123 becomes the upgrade target; Munger's $40 maps to the bear/conservative rows.

**How much credit for the right tail?** Damodaran optimistic **$194.16** / bull **$423.27** (20% / 10%); Buffett **$251**; Soros **$210** / extreme **$270**; Druckenmiller tail **$290**; Munger **$50**. All agree the tail is real but unproven — the dispute is weighting. **Concessions:** Damodaran concedes his bull cell is model-consistent but assumption-extreme; Soros concedes $270 is a reflexivity re-rating path, not a DCF; Buffett will not defend above $251. **Resolved:** consensus optimistic ~**$185**, bull ~**$290**, combined ~30% — the tail justifies watching, not paying.

**What price compensates for the uncertainty?** Buy zones span Under $45 (Munger) to $115–140 (Soros). **Concessions:** Druckenmiller concedes $110–135 is a trading zone, not a value zone; Munger concedes his $45 requires the bear scenario to arrive as price, and accepts the composite ladder. **Resolved:** do not initiate at or above ~$150; starter **$95–115**, accumulate **$75–95**, conviction **Under $75** — a dispute about sizing and temperament, not about today's price.

**Management: excellence vs the disclosure retreat.** For: candid founder, $3.1M cash comp, 11.3:1 pay ratio, SBC declining, $1B buyback into the post-earnings dip at ~$157.57. Against: ~74% voting control, SBC ~39% of net income, buybacks at ~29× FCF, and retiring the logged-in DAUq disclosure “right as the metric turns.” **Concessions:** Buffett 7→6; Munger rounds 6.5 down; Soros concedes the retreat is a credibility ding, not proven fraud. **Resolved:** consensus management score **6/10**.

**Is Google dependence the valuation-critical variable?** ~50% of traffic Google-sourced; the ~$60M/yr licensing renewal is binary and unobservable (management only knows one side). **Concessions:** Soros concedes the renewal is a bounded binary (~10–20% of the tail), not the whole case; Druckenmiller concedes macro (10Y 4.65%) is a multiplier, not a driver. **Resolved:** the durability of Google-sourced traffic is the one variable; monitoring hierarchy: Google referral health → DAUq (US logged-in) → ARPU → licensing renewal → SBC % revenue → Q3'26 print.

weighted.text: At **$151.71** that is roughly **−18.6% expected upside** and **≈ −4.0% 5-year annualized** — **a negative expected return with no margin of safety**. The consensus weighted value (~$124) sits modestly below Damodaran's verified workbook-weighted $141.61, because the two SBC-expensing lenses (Buffett, Munger) drag the base and tail cells down. Reverse-DCF check (uncontested, Damodaran §12): the $151.71 price embeds **~53% Y1 revenue growth at a 12.0% WACC** — bull-case execution priced as the base expectation. Downside tail: −70% (workbook bear $45.27); upside tail: +179% (workbook bull $423.27). Confidence: **Low/Medium**.

conclusions.title: The Five Consensus Conclusions
items: **The Business.** Reddit is one of the great consumer-internet franchises — “the toll booth on human conversation” — a wide-moat community network with 91.4% gross margins, 36.7% FCF margins, near-zero capital intensity, a $2.77B net-cash fortress, and a 26B+ post corpus that search engines and AI labs pay to license. The business quality is not in dispute.

**The Economics.** The sole determinant of long-term value is the durability of Google-sourced traffic. If the referral pathway holds, ARPU compounding (+36%) makes the base case conservative; if AI search re-platforms it, the bear/conservative outcomes ($45.27 / $70.40 workbook, 35% combined) arrive. Monitoring hierarchy: Google referral health → DAUq (US logged-in) → ARPU → data-licensing renewal → SBC % revenue → Q3'26 print.

**The Market's Expectations.** At $151.71 the market assumes ~53% first-year revenue growth at a 12% WACC (Damodaran's reverse DCF) — bull-case execution priced as the base expectation, ~26% above consensus revenue. The $215.63 average PT is anchored to forward non-GAAP EPS (~$7.56) that ignores normalized taxes and the SBC bill. Aggressive, not impossible — and no bargain.

**The Valuation.** Consensus base intrinsic value ~$100/share; probability-weighted ~$124/share; bear ~$50; bull ~$290 with a workbook extreme of $423.27. Damodaran's verified workbook: $45.27 / $70.40 / $109.50 / $194.16 / $423.27, weighted $141.61. Confidence: Low/Medium. Both the consensus base and the consensus weighted value are below the $151.71 price — expected upside ≈ −19%, 5-year annualized ≈ −4.0%.

**The Investment Decision.** C — HOLD / WATCH at $151.71; do not initiate at or above ~$150. Begin accumulating at $95–115, build at $75–95, full conviction under $75 (Munger's prices below $45), provided the monitoring hierarchy stays intact. Upgrades require proof — the Q3'26 print, the Google renewal, and ARPU durability, not the stock price, will deliver the verdict.

judgment.title: Final Consensus Judgment
judgment.paragraph: At a price of **$151.71**, the market is effectively paying for Reddit to execute its optimistic scenario — ~53% first-year growth, sustained ARPU compounding, and a benign Google relationship — with essentially no penalty for the ~$338M/yr SBC bill, the binary licensing renewal, or the controlled-company governance. Six independent frameworks — owner-earnings value, multidisciplinary quality, fundamental DCF, macro/liquidity expectations, reflexivity, and trend trading — all refuse to buy at this price. Five land on a **C (Hold/Watch)** or better-but-conditional (Druckenmiller C+, Soros B−), and one reads the chart as an outright **D**. We agree the franchise is exceptional, the moat is wide on the community side and rented on the distribution side, SBC is the per-share tax, management is excellent-but-scored-6/10 for the disclosure retreat, and the valuation already pays for the optimistic path. The most dangerous risks are a structural Google-referral decline, a terminated data-licensing deal, an SBC re-acceleration, and a de-rating spiral on the first further deceleration. Therefore, at today's price the consensus is to **hold and wait**: do not initiate at or above ~$150, accumulate in stages at **$95–115** and **$75–95**, buy with conviction **under $75**, and let the Q3'26 print, the Google renewal, and the ARPU trajectory — not the AI-victim narrative or the index membership — decide whether this wonderful company becomes a wonderful investment.

This document is an educational synthesis of estimates about estimates — it is not investment advice, and no valuation herein should be treated as a price prediction or a recommendation to trade. Reddit's outcome distribution is wide; treat every number on this page as a hypothesis, not a fact.
